page_copy.pattern: Traditional portfolios require maintaining 50+ HTML files. Updates mean editing each file individually. Adding entries means copying templates and linking manually.
page_copy.action: Designed hybrid SPA architecture using 404 routing trick + JSON content system. Two HTML templates dynamically populate from entry files. Manifest generation automates URL mapping.
page_copy.measured: Result: Add new entries by creating one JSON file. Update design once, all pages update. Infinite scalability with zero code duplication.
